mapper.select: SELECT d.draft_id AS draftId, d.slot_no AS slotNo, d.title AS title, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(d.content, ''), '<[^>]*>', ''), 50) AS preview, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments a WHERE a.draft_id = d.draft_id AND a.attachment_type = 'file' AND a.state = 'normal') AS attachCnt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM drafts d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC

SELECT draft_id AS draftId, slot_no AS slotNo, board_id AS boardId, title AS title, content AS content, category_id AS categoryId, is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM drafts WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT attachment_id AS attachmentId, file_name AS originName, file_size AS fileSize, file_url AS fileUrl FROM attachments WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} AND attachment_type = 'file' AND state = 'normal'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drafts (user_id, slot_no, board_id, category_id, title, content, is_anonymous, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotNo}, #{boardId}, #{req.categoryId}, #{req.title}, #{req.content}, #{req.isAnonymous}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE attachments SET post_id = #{postId}, draft_id = NULL WHERE draft_id = #{draftId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachments (post_id, draft_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, attachment_type, uploaded_by, state, created_at) VALUES (NULL, NULL, #{a.originName}, #{a.fileUrl}, #{a.fileSize}, #{a.fileType}, #{a.attachmentType}, #{a.uploadedBy}, 'normal', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT file_url AS fileUrl, file_type AS fileType, file_name AS originName FROM attachments WHERE attachment_id = #{attachmentId} AND state = 'normal'
SELECT file_url FROM attachments WHERE post_id IS NULL AND draft_id IS NULL AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachments WHERE post_id IS NULL AND draft_id IS NULL AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)
